The '''Battle of Shumavar''' was a battle during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Former [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] star [[Kob Mondray]] fought for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] in this battle.
